evidence.evidence_text: A new method called SkillAggregation is proposed, which learns to combine estimates from LLM judges without needing additional data or ground truth.
It extends the Crowdlayer aggregation method, developed for image classification, to exploit the judge estimates during inference.
The approach is compared to a range of standard aggregation methods on HaluEval-Dialogue, TruthfulQA and Chatbot Arena tasks.
